correctness.rationale: Explicit 20-vertex cubic GP(10,2) graph and closed-neighborhood face test. Independent exhaustive examination of 2^20 subsets found 425028 nonempty simplices and the asserted f-vector; checked reverse and forward greedy Morse matchings on every one of 3559600 incidences with 425028-vertex directed acyclic Hasse diagrams. Reverse critical cells (0:1,9:14,10:3,11:10), 212500 pairs, integral signed d10 rank 2 and d11 0; forward critical cells (0:1,9:15,10:6,11:12), 212497 pairs, integer d10 rank 3 and d11 rank 2, each exhibiting unimodular maximal minors. Resulting integral groups 12/1/10 in degrees 9/10/11 and no torsion, plus no cells 1..8 proves exact 8-connectivity. Larger homotopy type unasserted.

originality.rationale: Resultary exact, graph-alias and duality searches recovered dodecahedral independence, two-independence, forest, open-neighborhood and matching complexes, and other graph dominance complexes, but not the complement-of-dominating-set complex of dodecahedron. Matsushita–Wakatsuki Theorem 1.1 gives Alexander duality with the neighborhood complex of the GRAPH COMPLEMENT; it does not give dodecahedral group ranks. Forest/chordal dominance theorems do not apply to dodecahedral induced pentagons. Best-of-knowledge original with explicit unindexed-coverage risk.
